title: Regularity of solutions of the Dyson equation and applications
summary: The goal of this short paper is to investigate the regularity of the solutions of the Dyson equation. In the work of Bertucci and al. [3, 4, 5], a new notion of solutions for the Dyson equation has been introduced using the viscosity solutions theory and they proved a regularization of solutions in L^{$\infty$} . According to the work of Biane [6] we should expect a regularization in C^{1/3} of solutions (and not better). In the spirit of the works of Bertucci and al., we shall prove using PDE methods that for almost all time t \ge 0 the solution is as expected in C^{1/3} . Our approach…
